seoTitle: Can Smartsheet Send Automated Emails? Yes, Here's How
metaDescription: Set up automated email alerts in Smartsheet with the Automation menu, a trigger template, conditional filters, and a personalized message.
intro: Smartsheet can absolutely send automated emails, and the whole setup happens inside a single visual workflow builder without any scripting. This guide covers opening the Automation menu from a live sheet, starting from a ready-made template instead of building from scratch, and narrowing the trigger down to something specific, like a task hitting 100% complete, so the right people get notified at the right moment instead of on every single row change.

steps.heading: Open the Automation menu from your sheet
steps.body: From an active sheet, like the project schedule Gantt view shown here, click Automation in the top menu bar next to File and Forms. This opens the entry point to Smartsheet's workflow builder, where every automated action for that sheet gets created and managed. Automation lives at the sheet level, so each sheet has its own independent set of workflows.

image.caption: A project schedule sheet with the Automation menu open in the toolbar, the starting point for building an email workflow.

steps.heading: Start from a template instead of a blank workflow
steps.body: The Automation Template Gallery lists pre-built options grouped by purpose, and "Alert someone when specified criteria are met" is one of the most useful starting points for email reminders. The template preview explains what it's good for, like notifying stakeholders about at-risk statuses or alerting teammates when a task's phase changes, and spells out the three pieces you'll configure: a trigger, optional conditions, and an action. Clicking Use Template drops a working skeleton into the builder that you then customize rather than assembling one from an empty canvas.

image.caption: The Automation Template Gallery's preview panel for the "Alert someone when specified criteria are met" template, explaining its use cases and setup steps.

steps.heading: Set the trigger and the recipient
steps.body: In the workflow builder, the Trigger block defaults to "When rows are changed," watching any field for changes and running the workflow as soon as one is detected. Below it, the Alert someone action lets you send to specific people by typing a name or email, or route the message to everyone shared to the sheet. A Customize message link and a note confirming the email will be sent from Smartsheet Automation round out the action block, and a small plus button below lets you chain additional steps onto the same workflow.

image.caption: The workflow builder showing a Trigger block set to "When rows are changed" connected to an Alert someone action.

steps.heading: Narrow the trigger to a specific condition
steps.body: A workflow that fires on any field change will get noisy fast, so change the trigger's When condition to something specific, such as % Complete changes to 100%. That turns a generic "something happened" alert into a targeted one that only fires when a task actually finishes, which is exactly the kind of signal a project manager wants in their inbox instead of a flood of minor edits. You can click "Specify another change" to stack multiple conditions on the same trigger if you need it even more precise.

image.caption: The same trigger reconfigured to fire only when the % Complete field changes to 100%, with the Alert someone action still attached below it.

steps.heading: Personalize the message content
steps.body: Open Customize message to pull dynamic row data, like Task Name or Status, directly into the email's subject or body instead of sending a generic notification. This is what makes the alert actually useful to the recipient, since they see which task changed and what its new state is without having to open the sheet first.

steps.heading: Review delivery permissions and test it
steps.body: Before turning the workflow on, check whether it should be restricted to people already shared to the sheet or opened up to external stakeholders, since that setting controls who's even eligible to receive the alert. Once it looks right, save the workflow and make a live test change, like flipping a task's % Complete to 100%, to confirm the email actually arrives the way you configured it before relying on it for real deadlines.

faq.question: Does Smartsheet support automated email notifications?
faq.answer: Yes, the Automation menu on any sheet lets you build workflows that send emails based on triggers like a field changing or a due date approaching.

faq.question: Can I personalize the automated email content?
faq.answer: Yes, the Customize message option lets you dynamically pull row data like Task Name and Status into the subject or body of the email.

faq.question: Can automated emails go to people outside my organization?
faq.answer: Delivery controls let you choose whether messages are restricted to people already shared to the sheet or sent to external stakeholders as well.

faq.question: Can I limit reminders to only specific task conditions?
faq.answer: Yes, setting the trigger's When condition to a specific value, like % Complete reaching 100%, keeps the workflow from firing on every minor edit.

faq.question: Do I have to build the workflow from scratch?
faq.answer: No, the Automation Template Gallery includes ready-made templates like "Alert someone when specified criteria are met" that you can customize instead of starting blank.
